SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM profiles p INNER JOIN roles r ON r.role_id = p.role_id WHERE p.profile_id = #{profileId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.is_deleted = false
AND r.role_name IN ('STAFF', 'MANAGER')
AND r.role_name = 'STAFF' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM profile_shops target_ps INNER JOIN profile_shops mgr_ps ON mgr_ps.shop_id = target_ps.shop_id WHERE target_ps.profile_id = p.profile_id AND target_ps.deleted_at IS NULL AND mgr_ps.profile_id = #{currentUserId} AND mgr_ps.deleted_at IS NULL )
AND 1 = 0
)
SELECT role_name FROM roles WHERE role_id = #{roleId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND is_deleted = false
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM shops WHERE shop_id = #{shopId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND is_deleted = false )
mapper.sql: SELECT i.invoice_id AS invoiceId, i.shop_id AS shopId, i.table_id AS tableId, i.profile_id AS profileId, i.total_amount AS totalAmount, i.status::text AS status, i.is_deleted AS isDeleted, i.created_at AS createdAt, i.update_at AS updateAt FROM invoices i WHERE i.invoice_id = #{invoiceId} AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.is_deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE
SELECT table_id FROM shop_tables WHERE table_id = #{tableId} AND shop_id = #{shopId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND is_deleted = FALSE AND status = 2 FOR UPDATE
AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.is_deleted = FALSE AND i.status = 0
SELECT 1 FROM invoices i WHERE i.table_id = #{tableId}
